html:
Question 10
?

Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function f(x,y,z)=x2−y2−z+2?

a
A family of hyperboloids of one sheet: z2+y2−x2=C2
b
A family of paraboloids: z=x2+y2+C
c
A family of hyperbolic paraboloids: z=x2−y2+C
d
A family of hyperbolic paraboloids: z=y2−x2+C
e
A family of hyperboloids of two sheets: z2+y2−x2=−C2
